title: [Subcontracting] Bug 641405: Production Order actions in ILE page not clickable for transfer lines
summary: Production Order, Routing, and Components actions on the Item Ledger Entries page are now clickable for subcontracting transfer-type items by reading the production order from the Subc. Prod. Order fields when the base Order fields point to a transfer order instead.
key_points: Actions are now enabled when Subc. Prod. Order No. is set, not just when base Order No. is a production order
SetProdOrderInformationByVariant resolves production order from Subc. Prod. Order fields as a fallback
Fixes greyed-out actions for transfer-type subcontracting Item Ledger Entries
Test coverage added for the fix
